factual_claims.source_evidence: The Event after the reporting period section states TKM Auto OÜ 'will acquire a 100% interest in three companies engaged in the retail sale and servicing of vehicles' (Rohe Auto AS, SKO Motors OÜ, and a real estate holding company). This describes expansion, not abandonment or sale.

factual_claims.claim: It also announced a successful entry into the Finnish grocery market through a newly opened supermarket chain.
factual_claims.label: NOT_FOUND

numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: The Financial Performance section states: 'The Group’s audited consolidated sales revenue for 2025 amounted to 919.6 million euros, representing a decrease of 2.6% compared to 2024, when sales revenue totalled 944.6 million euros.'

numerical_claims.source_evidence: The Financial Performance section states: 'The Group’s profit before tax for 2025 was 24.3 million euros, declining by 31.4% year on year.'

numerical_claims.claim: Supermarkets net profit increased by 38.6 percent to 9.5 million euros
numerical_claims.label: INCORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: The segment reporting table shows supermarkets net profit was 9.5 million euros in 2025 compared to 15.5 million euros in 2024, representing a 38.6% decrease, not an increase.
numerical_claims.error_explanation: The candidate incorrectly states a profit increase where the source reports a decrease.
